name: Cron Service Manager
description: Allows to move all your hook_cron() implementations to service classes.
project_description: Cron Service Manager lets developers move hook_cron() logic out of .module files into tagged service classes. A service collector (tag 'cron_service') gathers every service implementing CronServiceInterface; on each hook_cron() the CronServiceManager iterates them and calls execute(). Optional interfaces add scheduling (ScheduledCronServiceInterface::getNextExecutionTime()) and per-run gating (TimeControllingCronServiceInterface::shouldRunNow()). Next-run timestamps, last-run timestamps and a per-service 'forced' flag are persisted in Drupal State. Individual jobs can be run/forced independently via the manager API, and errors during a job dispatch a CronServiceErrorEvent instead of aborting the whole cron run. The module ships no routes, config or UI of its own; the optional cron_service_ui submodule adds an admin listing and a 'force on next cron run' action.
